data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 234.098m (balance sheet prior-year column). The report discloses adverse prior year development (net) of GBP 5.3m, predominantly in the Marine division, indicating an overall strengthening of reserves. Separately, 2014 results were materially impacted by three market-wide Aviation War losses (MH370, MH17 and Tripoli Airport siege) which affected the Aviation portfolio in the current year. No gross prior-year movement figure was presented in the notes, so the reported net adverse development has been used as the quantified prior year movement.
